review_notes: I read the whole file, with no related sources opened. It has almost no simp interface. The only simp attribute is `@[scoped simp] private lemma val_unitOf`, which is a `rfl` coercion lemma. Its left-hand side is the coercion of `unitOf f hf`, and its right-hand side is `algebraMap F E f`. That orientation is the normal form, since it removes the custom definition. It is scoped to `QuadraticNormSet` and is used only in `ni_of_card_eq_two` and `unitOf_mem_ker`, so I see no competing rule or cycle. Elsewhere the file uses `rw`, `simp only` or `field_simp` explicitly: `val_fieldUnitsAct`, `val_fieldUnitsDerive`, `val_fieldUnitsNorm` and `conj_repr` are applied by `rw`. They are private, tied to specific hypotheses, or have a non-confluent shape such as `y * g y`. I could not justify making any of them simp lemmas, so I report no finding. I did not check Mathlib or the imported Definitions/Theorems for duplicates of the local lemmas. Nothing in the file points to a concrete simp-set problem.
